profile.overview: Selesnya Conclave is a white-green guild associated with Ravnica.
profile.philosophy: The self finds peace by becoming part of a greater living community.
profile.core_tension: Selesnya offers belonging, harmony, and care, but it also asks the individual voice to yield to the communal one.
profile.social_or_institutional_role: The official guide presents Selesnya as a collectivist nature-centered guild led through Mat'Selesnya and Trostani in the cited era.
profile.mechanics_and_play_pattern: Convoke expresses Selesnya solidarity by allowing a community of creatures to help cast spells.
profile.placement_use: Use this profile to support thematic placement, quiz design, and lore browsing. Do not present placement inferences as canon.

limitations: This is a compact first-pass JSON package generated from official overview and mechanics sources.
